verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm cubic serves an llms.txt at docs.cubic.dev/llms.txt. Its docs pages have markdown mirrors that point agents to the documentation index, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Agent skills documentation and per-endpoint OpenAPI markdown mirrors reinforce this, but there is no independent or community hands-on report of agents actually consuming these docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of agents using llms.txt, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-corpus variant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.cubic.dev/llms.txt # cubic documentation
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.cubic.dev/llms.txt
